mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2% annualized coincides with higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 2% YoY for 3 months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is not positive in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, pushing wage growth and profit margins higher, which lifts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4% for 2 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are not positive in at least 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals weakening manufacturing demand, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95 for 2 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are not negative in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month period where the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% coincides with higher discount rates and lower equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 3 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are not negative in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 new jobs per month signals robust labor demand, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS 3-month YoY growth > 2.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are not positive in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,400,000 units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1400 for 2 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are not negative in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month period where CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% while the federal funds rate remains below 2% signals a delayed policy response, which erodes real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 103 and FEDFUNDS < 2 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 103 and FEDFUNDS < 2 for 3 months, S&P 500 20-day returns are not negative in at least 60% of cases.
